🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 7, 2026

Moon, in Virgo, holds a square to Uranus, in Gemini. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Sun in Libra stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Fire moves first and pays first. Four weeks ago Mars was still in Cancer: the ground has moved.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Virgo, Moon concedes the point early. Earth keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Since Venus crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, holds no rank in Scorpio and simply works. Moon squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Mutable air: keeping options is the expense. The Virgo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Virgo. From Libra, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal water starts and is invoiced for it. A week ago Moon was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you from Libra, where it stands lowest. From Scorpio, Mercury cuts across the appetite. Fire holds on, and the holding is billed. Sun left Virgo four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Mutable earth: the alternatives turn out identical. The trine to Moon that held two weeks ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. With Sun in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Air starts and settles in the same breath. Venus turned back a week ago; the review is still running.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon sextiles you from Virgo: help that waits to be asked for. Fixed water: nothing needs letting go of today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Moon squares you from Virgo, and something has to give way. Fire that changes shape, charged for each shape. The opposition of two weeks ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, is at its lowest in Aries: effort costs double. Moon trines you from Virgo, meeting no resistance. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. Jupiter let go of it two weeks ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Fixed air keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon faces you from Virgo: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Mutable water keeps two accounts open and pays both. Nothing about it is a week old.
